later_source_file_observation.relation_to_baseline: Same source URL, retrieved later. Original MP3 bytes were not hashed in the saved baseline report. Byte identity with the original baseline source/conversion is not established by URL equality.

review_steps: The exact converted baseline input was recovered and hash-checked in the saved evaluation report. For human review retrieve that same 21619-byte, SHA256-pinned upload from the authorized private archive; this follow-up did not recheck the audio bytes. A later download from the same URL is not a substitute.
Have two qualified Hafs reviewers listen independently before seeing the model indication. Record clip onset/end completeness, wasl/waqf context, permitted variation and any uncertainty.

Then review the indicated initial scalar/expected phoneme in this exact practice edition. Separate recording-boundary effects, reference/phonetic alignment and ASR differences from real pronunciation/tajweed findings.
Adjudicate disagreements. Keep an inconclusive status if expertise, context or input identity is insufficient; do not turn an unreviewed case into a precision/recall result.

Any new model run must pin current engine/model/reference hashes and use an explicitly selected input within the existing authorized scope. Never upload user recordings automatically or add audio to Git.

original_upload_archive_observation.scope: The saved evaluation records an exact original upload byte check. This independent follow-up reproduces its metadata and scoring; it has no copy of the original audio. No new inference or expert adjudication.
